output.headline: This recruiting GM pizza order fits the treasurer's exception for recruiting GMs, so the higher per-head rate is backed.

reasons.text: At [[S-per-head]] a head, it is above the usual [[S-target-per-head]] target (C-03) and the recent average of [[S-recent-avg-per-head]], but under the [[S-note-cap-per-head]] ceiling the treasurer set on P-31 for recruiting GMs.
This is a recruiting GM with lab tours, the same kind of event P-31 covered. The board notes say recruiting GMs are decided case by case because new members come from them.
The order matches the [[S-attendees]] RSVPs (C-02). Slack says many more people plan to show up, so the headcount is likely to be higher than the RSVPs.
After this, [[S-above-reserve-after]] stays above the [[S-reserve]] reserve (C-04), so the end-of-semester social is still covered.
